p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
Extend to express two left shifts on a positive unsigned value with no overflow.
code_first.a: 12; 18; two left shifts correspond to ×4 under no overflow.

original_exam_questions: Explain the difference between RAM and virtual memory. [4 marks]
RAM is physical primary working memory; virtual memory uses secondary storage to back pages when RAM is insufficient.
State why a merge step requires sorted sublists. [3 marks]
Choosing the smaller front item produces an ordered result only when each incoming sublist is already ordered.

stretch.task: Change the code to demonstrate a left shift by two places using multiplication by4.
stretch.hint: Unsigned shifts act as multiplying by powers of2 only without overflow.

mastery.task: Write a calculator predicting eight-bit unsigned logical left shift and detecting overflow/lost bits; compare shift1 and shift2.
mastery.hint: Restrict results to 0–255; inspect bits shifted out.
mastery.answer: For 6 <<2, result24 no overflow; for 200<<1, mathematical400 cannot fit eight bits, so overflow/lost high bit should be identified.
